limitations: Public tests already analyzed; this is a nonblind follow-up, no public score enters selection.
Synthetic evidence-grounded deepseek-flash teacher and native checker use separate requests; external Jev audited only8 development cases. No human clinical adjudication.
Control reuses original training trajectory and is reselected/recalibrated on common holdouts.
Connected patient components, not pairs, define uncertainty; Reddit has one component.
New data jointly changes narrative style, length and comparison facts; this ablation does not separate those factors.
Fixed records and optimizer updates do not imply equal FLOPs; longer hard inputs change GPU time.
Local compute and teacher fees unknown without verified prices; original external Jev bill preserved.

original_protocol_deviations.reason: Approved plan requires final checkpoint selection before public test inference. Sequence was started early; retain existing outcomes as a protocol deviation and defer remaining submissions. No model/training hyperparameter choices may use these baseline results.
original_protocol_deviations.action: SIGSTOP applied to owned sequence only; already-submitted Synth child may finish; do not resume until validation selection is frozen.
